notes.title: Draw The Way 1.30 released!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27875605/2b307204e14cbc2d939b06fe8a83013f5766193c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27875605/2b307204e14cbc2d939b06fe8a83013f5766193c.gif[/img][/url]
[h2]About the 1.30 update ːthebunnyː[/h2]
[b][h3]Added:[/h3][/b]
- New turret (fires bouncy projectile)
- New drawing effect
- New fog effect
- New tutorial messages, gifs - tricks ;)
- New levels

[b][h3]Modified:[/h3][/b]
- Nightmare difficulty (more hardcore and darker)
- Menu system
- Tutorial messages
- Minor change in character speed and jump velocity
- Changed several levels and added more hazards to them

[b][h3]Fixed:[/h3][/b]
- Fixed a minor bug when drawing on anti-drawing field
- Fixed the player drawing bug that occured when the player was drawing while freezing time and died
- Other minor physics fixes about drawing (segments)

ːcureː And that's it, I hope you guys will enjoy the new update ːcureː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27875605/21284ca72881a18f357882aeea2472485a019c24.png[/img]

notes.title: End of Year - Overall update notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27875605/dc846405bf04b2b1e5aadf380568317956d7eb19.jpg[/img]

Greetings!
Thank you everyone for the support!
I wish everyone a very Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

[i]<A little look back this year>[/i]
Most important developments:
[h1][v0.85][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 6 new map
[*] Added a near-death slow'mo ability (which later binded to key)
[*] Minor optimization on drawing system
[*] Lightning bug fixed
[*] Fixed a physics bug (character sometimes stuck on ground)
[*] Fixed the drawing flickering bug
[/list]

[h1][v1.0 : Co-Op update][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added multiplayer (Co-Op)
[*] Added new maps for multiplayer
[*] Optimization on graphics and lightning (no more lag due to too many light rays in high and ultra graphics)
[*] Drawing system (mesh generation) and drawing graphics reworked
[/list]

[h1][v1.1][/h1]
[list]
[*] All character is available for Co-Op as well
[*] Added new effect, color and lightning for drawing. Each character has a unique color
[*] Added a few fog effect to the game (it can be turned off in the settings menu)
[*] Added a Brazilian Portuguese translation to the game (by Digital Kaz Brazil team)
[*] Fixed a multiplayer bug (in rare cases the player icon was flickering)
[*] Minor changes on maps ( easier maps )
[*] Lowered the turret range and reload speed by 20% (the final value is different in each difficulty)
[*] Lowered the bullet speed by 35% (the final value is different in each difficulty)
[/list]

 *****   Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!    *****

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27875605/21284ca72881a18f357882aeea2472485a019c24.png[/img]

notes.title: Draw The Way is now available on Linux!
notes.content:
Greetings heroes!

Are you ready to play [b]Draw The Way on Linux[/b]? Well, then your time has come!

Later on there will be MAC support as well.
Now I will work on Multiplayer mode. Meanwhile a few new maps and soon a new hero will come!

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with loading last selected hero.
[*]Fixed a bug when game crashing sometimes if you draw and get hit by a laser in the same time.
[/list]

[b]A very big thanks to Volnes, who helped me a lot with the Linux port![/b]

notes.title: Trading Cards | devblog
notes.content:
Greetings brave heroes!

The void brought [b]trading cards[/b] through the rifts, but be careful because danger awaits on your path!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27875605/5495be0f954dd6270aa76b37284b3dd4f311855e.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Updates[/b][/h1]
- Added: Temporary keybindings menu.
- Changed: A little bit finer movement (will be more finer).
- Changed: Slow'mo ability won't activate as reflex skill (use Q key to activate it).
- Changed: Default settings parameters.
- Removed: Menu cursor effect.
- Minor fixes and faster loading time.

Oh and.. Linux port in sight!

[i]Planned schedule updates:
- Linux port (and later on Mac as well)
- More maps
- Multiplayer mode (Co-op and later on Deathmatch and Capture The Flag)
- More heroes
- More Collectibles (eg: Drawing color and effect)
- Leveling and talent system (upgradeable heroes) [?][/i]

[h1][b]About multiplayer[/b][/h1]
[b] === Co-op mode ===[/b]
In this mode there would be only 2 players and they must rely on each other. One could draw and the other could freeze time. There would be a completely new map pack for co-op mode.
Hardcore maps for hardcore co-op players! ;)

[b] === Deathmatch ===[/b]
Deathmatch as we love it! There would be a few arenas where players could kill each other in a special way. (Eg. you could push your enemy to death with your drawing or draw a line for a laser to reflect it to the enemy player and so on)
There would be "eraser" skill too.
You could adjust the winning conditions. (to win: kill the most or last man standing, etc)

[b] === Capture The Flag ===[/b]
This multiplayer mode would be similiar than the Deathmatch, but to win you should capture the enemy flag for x times. 

[h1][b]About Leveling and talent system[/b] (in question) [/h1]
[b] === Leveling ===[/b]
All map would reward you with Develop Points when you finish the level. The more difficult the map the more DP you get!

[b] === Talent system ===[/b]
There would be a global skill tree and a hero unique. In the global skill tree you could spend your DP for passive/global upgrades. (eg. higher jump, longer drawing lifetime, more drawing energy and so on).
In the hero-oriented tree all heroes could do unique upgrades. (eg. for the bunny[double jump] hero you could jump third time, if you jump 2th or 3th time it would cause a time freeze blast which could freeze all "living" object in a radius and so on)

I have a lot of plans for everything and I try to offer the best! :)

Please feel free to discuss these planned updates!
